# Continuity cases for checkpoint_witness_v1.txt (fa-qtfd).
# Same DEVELOPMENT-ONLY keys, independent Python cryptography Ed25519 signatures.
# Every candidate, including conflicts/regressions, has five valid signatures.
# Roots are synthetic: the valid extension adds leaf 0xb2*32 after 0xa1*32.
# Same-sequence state/index/chain changes are genuine signed equivocations.
# The consistency frames are the existing fa:acc-consistency-proof:v1 format.
# Fixed vectors; no signing or regeneration occurs in the Rust tests.
